title: spec: an object declares when a whole record is read-only by hand (object-level uiReadonlyWhen), fields override it, and duplicating a record takes the locked fields' defaults
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbcAmwZGHVnPE8xJwr

Filing gate: ③ · Source: maintainer — ruling on objectstack-ai/objectstack#36806 (2026-11-26, decision thread 「裁决 #36806 只读字段命名」): 「按长远模型」 — the two-tier field-lock model is adopted whole, and its object-level half is filed now rather than waiting for an asker. Sub-issue of #36806 (phase 2 of that ruling).
Grade: area:data · Feature · p2 (takes the parent's grade) · evidence: the parent's measurement on 18.6.0 and the ruling.
Reader: area o5-D (seat `repo:objectstack#5`) after the parent lands; `domain:spec` inherited from the parent (sub-issue rule).

Blocked-by: #36806

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:作者可以在对象上写一句「状态是已确认或已完成时整单人手锁定」,表单、行内编辑、看板、日历、高亮条都改不了这条记录;备注这类字段可以单独放开;按钮、接口、导入、流程照常写。复制一张已确认的订单,得到的是草稿而不是另一张已确认订单。
- 为什么做:确认后的订单、已过账的发票、已关闭的工单都要整单锁定,逐字段写条件既累又容易漏一个字段;Frappe 的 docstatus、Salesforce 的审批锁、Odoo 的确认单锁都是整单一句话。
- 出错会怎样:漏掉某个界面入口时用户仍能手改,数据仍由校验规则兜底;回滚即去掉对象级键。
- 要你做什么:无,已在 #36806 的裁决里选定。

## Asked

1. Object-level `uiReadonlyWhen` (CEL predicate over `record`): when TRUE, every console surface treats every field of the record as read-only by hand (the surfaces #36806 lists: create/edit dialogs, record-page inline edit, highlight-strip chip, grid inline edit and multi-row save, kanban drag, calendar drag).
2. Field-level override: a field that declares its own `uiReadonly` or `uiReadonlyWhen` is judged by its own declaration, not the object's. `uiReadonlyWhen: P\`false\`` on a field keeps it editable inside a locked record (notes, internal tags).
3. The one console verdict helper from #36806 folds the object-level predicate in, so no surface reads it directly.
4. Duplicating a record from the console (the clone action a person triggers) does not copy a hand-locked field's value; the new record takes the field's `defaultValue`, as a console create does under #36806 item 3. Declared writes (API, import, actions, flows) are untouched.
5. `describe_object` (MCP) reports the object-level predicate so an agent acting for a person knows the record is hand-locked and reaches for an action instead of a direct write.
6. Write paths keep every write; the engine never reads the key (pin test: no `x-objectstack-dropped-fields` on a PATCH to a locked record).

## Done when

On a test object with a `state_machine` on `status`, `uiReadonlyWhen: P\`record.status in ['confirmed','done']\`` on the object and `uiReadonlyWhen: P\`false\`` on `notes`: a confirmed record offers no hand edit on any field except `notes`; a `PATCH`, an import update and a declarative action still change fields when validations allow; duplicating the confirmed record yields a record whose `status` is the field's `defaultValue`; `describe_object` reports the predicate.

## Governing text

- Ruling on #36806 (2026-11-26): two tiers (server lock `readonly`/`readonlyWhen`; hand lock `uiReadonly`/`uiReadonlyWhen`) × two levels (field, object); field declaration wins over object default; a `ui`-prefixed key is admitted only where the console's and the server's answers legitimately differ, today only for read-only.
- ADR-0085 §2 admission test: binds every surface, names no page — the object-level key names the console as a whole, not a page.
- ADR-0049: a declared key is enforced on every surface it names.

## Out of scope

An object-level `readonlyWhen` (server-side whole-record lock) is the symmetric completion the ruling allows later; it is not asked here. Turning the server strip into a refusal is a separate topic.
